/*
 * a52sxq-power.dtsi — charging, battery, fuel gauge, MUIC, USB-PD, direct charger, camera
 * PMIC and flash LED of the Samsung Galaxy A52s 5G for the Qualcomm 6.12 BSP base
 * (bsp612, yupik.dtb, downstream bindings).
 *
 * GENERATED by dt-extract/gen-dtsi.py from downstream-dt/a52sxq-r02.dts (the tree the phone
 * boots: yupik base + a52sxq_kor_single_w00_r02 overlay). Node bodies are copied verbatim
 * (decompiled form, hence hex and reversed property order); the only edits are: "phandle"
 * lines dropped and numeric phandles replaced by labels. SAFETY-CRITICAL DATA: do not edit
 * values here; change the generator or the source and re-run. See DT-VALUES.md.
 *
 * Hardware revisions: Samsung's r02 overlay is selected for hw_rev 2..0x20
 * (dtbo-hw_rev = <2>, dtbo-hw_rev_end = <0x20>), so revisions 3 and 4 on the bench use this
 * same data. r01 (hw_rev 1) and r00 are not covered here.
 *
 * Prerequisites in the including tree:
 *  - labels: soc, tlmm, usb0, eud, qupv3_se0_i2c, qupv3_se3_i2c, qupv3_se8_i2c (all in the
 *    6.12 yupik base) and pmk8350_vadc, pm7325_gpios (from pmk8350.dtsi / pm7325.dtsi; the
 *    plain yupik.dtb does not include the PMIC files, the a52sxq board file must).
 *  - nothing else may claim TLMM 54 (SM5714 irq), 140 (USB-PD irq), 96/97 (flash/torch
 *    enable), PM7325 GPIO 1-4 (thermistor ADC inputs).
 *
 * Never loaded on hardware (2026-11-11).
 */
